comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Hmm, very interesting. If I understand the translation correctly, this is available during World Clock's 17th Century, phases 3 through 5, at Helder's Item Shop for... 10 million ducats. A stackable consumable, you get your choice of one of the following items when using it:

Dougusoku
Kote
Bajougutsu
White Jade Kanzashi
Haori&Black Hakama
Happi
Haori&Black Hakama
Hyottoko Mask

There's also a bow and arrow and throwing knife I don't recognize. That said, I'm wondering if this will even be seen on GAMA, and if the contents will be even remotely the same, since a majority of the items up there were previously released as NC/Astro-only goodies. We'll see.

Images: ugougonya.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-135.html (all available items are viewable)
